data_fields.name: swift_pct_per_rank
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 percent of incoming XP per perk rank (integer product then /100)

best_idea: Credit each kill to the player side by its recorded attacker and pay XP through one cumulative threshold table with a loop that can grant several levels in one award, instead of one level per event.
decision_why: The credit rule, cumulative table and multi-level loop are the useful shape, but Frankendom must award at the server-verified kill into its one ledger, not hold a pool to fight end, and needs a credit rule for MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 that the donor lacks.
acceptance: A server test: after verified kills totalling X XP the level equals the table result; one large award grants every crossed level's hit-point gain; a kill credited to an enemy-side attacker adds 0 XP.
